source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 744 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 744 was established by Ordinance No. 26345, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 10, 2006. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 744 is established on property bounded by Edgeworth Drive, Zurich Drive, Haymarket Road, and Turnbow Drive. The size of PD 744 is approximately 12.339 acres. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 744A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted in this district are those main uses permitted in the R-10(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-10(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R- 10(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-10(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) A public school other than an open-enrollment charter school is permitted by right. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations in Subsection (e), “R-10(A) District,” of Section 51A-4.112, “Single Family Districts,” apply in this district.

(b) Front yard.

(1) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, the minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, off-street parking is permitted in the front yard along Edgeworth Drive.

(c) Side and rear yard. For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, the minimum side and rear yards are as shown on the development plan.

(d) Height. For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, maximum structure height is 48 feet.

(e) Lot coverage. For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, maximum lot coverage is 25 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, a minimum of 54 off- street parking and loading spaces must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(c) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, additional off-street parking must be provided when additional classrooms are located or constructed within the buildable area shown on the development plan.

(d) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, the applicant must provide a traffic management plan prior to the issuance of a building permit. The traffic management plan must show:

(1) Pick-up and drop-off locations.

(2) Ingress and egress points.

(3) Queuing length required and provided.

(4) Number and locations of school administrators assisting with loading and unloading.

The traffic management plan must be filed with the department of public works and transportation and updated each year in the summer prior to the start of the new school year. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Fence
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.111. FENCE.

For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, maximum fence height is six feet. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) For a public school other than an open-enrollment charter school, signs are permitted only in the sizes and at the locations shown on the development plan. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26345)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-744.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 744 is located on Zoning Map No. N-11. (Ord. 26345)
